item_text: I think that something really bad would happen to me if I were to visit a dentist.
proposed_label: question about negative cognition regarding dental care
proposed_definition: A question that assesses an individual's negative or catastrophic thoughts or beliefs about dental visits or dental treatment, such as expecting that something harmful or bad will happen.
logical_definition: question AND (is about some negative cognition regarding dental care)
new_concept_definition: A cognition in which an individual holds negative or catastrophic thoughts or beliefs about dental visits or dental treatment, such as expecting harm, danger, or a bad outcome.
rationale: The item asks about a catastrophic belief that something bad would happen when visiting a dentist, which is a cognition (GO_0050890). It is not avoidance behavior, a physiological arousal process, or a specific procedure or visit phase, and the anticipatory-fear class is a fixed DFS item list, so a new class about negative dental cognitions is proposed.

item_text: My fear of going to the dentist has been present for at least 6 months.
proposed_label: question about duration of dental fear
proposed_definition: A question that assesses how long an individual's fear or anxiety about dental care or dental visits has persisted, such as whether it has been present for a minimum period of time.
logical_definition: question AND (is about some persistent dental fear)
new_concept_definition: An unpleasant emotional experience of fear or anxiety directed at dental care or dental visits that persists over an extended period of time (e.g., at least 6 months).
rationale: The item measures how long the person's fear of going to the dentist has lasted (at least 6 months), not a specific avoidance behavior, visit phase, procedure, stimulus or bodily arousal; the DFS-list classes exclude non-DFS items, so a new class about persistent dental fear, an emotional experience, is proposed.

item_text: Not knowing what the dentist is going to do.
proposed_label: question about uncertainty regarding a dental procedure
proposed_definition: A question that is about a patient's lack of knowledge or uncertainty about what dental procedure will be performed or what will happen during a dental visit.
logical_definition: question AND (is about some uncertainty about dental procedure)
new_concept_definition: A phenomenal cognitive experience during a dental visit in which a patient is aware of lacking knowledge about what dental procedure the dental health care provider is going to perform.
rationale: The item measures anxiety, while at the dentist, about the unknown nature of what the dentist will do, so it is about a dental procedure (a process during a dental visit) and maps to dental procedure question (OHD_0008044); no existing class captures the core construct of uncertainty or lack of information, so a reusable child class is proposed for this and similar items.

proposed_label: question about cost of dental treatment
proposed_definition: A question that is about the financial cost of, or payment for, dental treatment.
logical_definition: question AND (is about some payment for dental treatment)
new_concept_definition: A planned process in which a patient or a third party pays the financial cost of dental treatment provided by a dental health care provider.
rationale: The item asks about anxiety over the financial cost of dental treatment, which is not a dental procedure, avoidance behavior, physiological arousal, waiting-room process, or defined before/during/after-visit process, so no existing class fits and a new cost-of-treatment question class is proposed.

proposed_definition: A question that is about some injection procedure performed on a patient during a dental visit, such as an injection of local anesthetic.
logical_definition: [OHD_0008044] dental procedure question AND (is about some dental injection procedure)
new_concept_definition: A dental procedure in which a needle is used to inject a substance, such as a local anesthetic, into the oral tissues of a patient.
rationale: The item asks about anxiety over needles or injections received at the dentist, which is a dental procedure (OHD_0000002), so it satisfies dental procedure question (OHD_0008044); no injection-specific subclass exists alongside the drilling and cleaning ones, so a dental-injection subclass is proposed; the DFS-list-defined classes (OHD_0008046, and OHD_0008054 under OHD_0008007) are excluded because this is not a listed DFS item.

proposed_definition: A question that is about an individual's experience of, or fear of, gagging or choking, for example during dental treatment.
logical_definition: question AND (is about some gagging or choking)
new_concept_definition: A pathological bodily process in which the throat contracts reflexively (gagging) or the airway is obstructed or felt to be obstructed (choking), commonly triggered by stimulation of the mouth or throat.
rationale: The item asks about anxiety over gagging or choking that happens while at the dentist, which places it under 'question about during dental visit' (OHD_0008039); because no existing concept captures gagging or choking (nausea is the only pathological bodily process listed), a new concept 'gagging or choking' under pathological bodily process (OGMS_0000061) is proposed, with a matching question class under 'question about physiological arousal' (OHD_0008047).
